critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: React Router v6 emits two console warnings on every navigation about v7 future flags (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath). Optional: opt-in via future={{v7_startTransition: true, v7_relativeSplatPath: true}} on <BrowserRouter> to silence.

Minor: ThemeProvider toggles 'light' on <html>, but body className still contains hardcoded 'bg-[#050505] text-white' (set in index.html / index.css). Light-mode visuals are handled via Tailwind '[.light_&]:' variants in CSS - works correctly, but the hardcoded body classes are a subtle smell. Visual sanity in light mode looked acceptable per design intent.
Minor: featured slides scale-down (0.95) + opacity 0.55 + no external gradient bars confirmed via Projects.jsx; matches design spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All refinement items from the original request are visually + functionally verified. data.js is the source of truth for journey/experiences/achievements/projects (including case-study slugs). 5 case study slugs: wana, palmora, finconnect, isec, bi-dashboard. data-testid coverage is excellent: primary-navbar, navbar-logo, navbar-mobile-toggle, navbar-mobile-overlay, theme-toggle, projects-section, featured-carousel, featured-slide-{id}, featured-dot-{i}, featured-prev/next/autoplay-toggle, case-studies-section, case-study-{id}, footer, footer-copyright. The stability fix (useScrolledPast + no StrictMode) is working - no remount storm observed.
